source_law.text: When official traffic-control devices are erected giving notice thereof, a person shall not drive a vehicle onto or from any controlled-access highway except at those entrances and exits which are indicated by such devices.

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Separate device authority, content, erection, entrance extent and original pixel source required; original authority unresolved.
